Safari image-loading overrides for MediaFigure: a
Sourcesrc/core/safari/patches/media-figure/image-load.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

safariLoadHighRes

Safari loadHighRes: requests the Q50 (medium) variant instead of the uncompressed source — the medium tier is the decode-safe asset for WebKit's ~4096px image ceiling, so every source (however large the original) gets a real high-res paint instead of a permanent thumb. The URL is emission-encoded exactly like load.ts's path — raw concatenation breaks on bucket keys carrying spaces/non-ASCII, which Safari resolves to a 404 where Chromium tolerated the literal.

bindSafariImageLoad

Lazy-thumbnail + img-observer wiring for non-hero images: the thumb defers via loading=lazy and the Q50 swap triggers once the figure scrolls within ROOT_MARGIN_50 of the viewport.
